metadata.case_name: HO KING LAM v. LEE CHIEN HUA

injuries.description: His right hip joint was dislocated.
source: His right hip joint was dislocated.
He was then sent to the A&E department of Princess Margaret Hospital (“PMH”), where he was diagnosed to have suffered from a fractured right pelvis and dislocation of the right hip joint.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of unspecified pelvic bone without disruption of posterior arch of pelvic ring

injuries.description: Brachial plexus injury of his right arm
source: He also suffered what is medically known as brachial plexus injury of his right arm.
Later he was also found to have suffered from right brachial plexus injury.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple nerves at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Avascular necrosis and collapse of the head of the femoral bone (complete destruction of right hip joint)
injuries.body_part: head of right femoral bone / right hip joint
source: His right hip joint suffered a complete destruction followed by complication of avascular necrosis and collapse of the head of the femoral bone.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

injuries.description: Right leg is shortened by 5 cm
source: His right leg is shortened by 5 cm and he walks with a limp and could not fully squat.

manifestations.description: Right arm is no longer of any practical functional use
Could not fully squat because of his right hip problem
Right upper arm movement is severely reduced and affected; could only lift his right arm up to shoulder level
Total disability of the right upper arm

treatments_received: 5 operations for fractured right pelvis with dislocated hip joint and right brachial plexus injury

losses.description: Right arm no longer of any practical functional use; right upper arm movement severely reduced; right hip joint destroyed with avascular necrosis and collapse of the head of the femoral bone; right leg shortened by 5 cm.
Walks with a limp and could not fully squat because of his right hip problem.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Would need help for major household works such as laundry, and cleaning the home if necessary.
Unable to pursue his intended career as a licensed electrician and is practically unable to find any gainful employment by reason of the injuries.

comparable_cases.case_name: Li Yuet Yee v Ng Chi Hang
comparable_cases.injury_description: Closed fracture of her right femur, dislocation of her left knee and fracture of her right acetabulum; reduction of her hip joint space; needed total hip and knee replacements; separation of her right sacro-iliac joint and fracture of tip of left transverse process of 5th vertebra; adjustment disorder; unable to resume work.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cham Cheung Sing v Yung Pak Wa
comparable_cases.injury_description: Plaintiff had no effective movement below the neck except limited shoulder movement; assessed at 98% impairment of the whole person.

comparable_cases.case_name: Cheung Wai Ping v Chan Yuen Yee
comparable_cases.injury_description: Irreparable brain damage; could no longer conduct his own affairs and needed to be looked after for most of the time.
